Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on the interactome of the BCC7 protein, using anti-FLAG affinity beads to capture the protein and its partners from T. gondii tachyzoite lysates. Human HFF cells were used as the host for parasite propagation, and the Mascot search included Homo sapiens taxonomy, justifying the mixed_species_flag.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is an interactome study using affinity purification (Co-IP) to compare proteins associated with the tagged BCC7 protein versus a wild-type/parental control. While the paper also describes an Auxin-Inducible Degron (AID) system for protein depletion, that specific perturbation was used for phenotypic assays (plaque assays, microscopy) and not for the quantitative MS-based interactome analysis described in section 4.9 and 2.4.
